title: Permissionless collectReward re-anchors stable rewardPerSecond over a fresh depletionDuration (grief)
description: collectReward is permissionless and, after topping up rewardBalance, recomputes rewardPerSecond over a full fresh depletionDuration (L570). A third party can repeatedly restart the stable-reward decay schedule. Distinct from H-01 (promo accumulator advance) — this is the stable rate window only.
impact: Griefing of the stable-reward schedule, no fund theft. The amount>0 gate (L560) forces each call to contribute a real non-zero deposit, so it is costly and self-limiting; reward accounting stays correct.
recommendation: When topping up an already-active window, blend/extend the remaining schedule rather than resetting depletionDuration, or gate the rate-recompute path against unprivileged callers.
priorArtCrossRef: ledger M-02 (V1 collectReward permissionless griefing, acknowledged, downgraded to Low)
